sections.theory:
Exercise questions

1. Choose and write the suitable answers.

i. In cricket the place at a distance of 22 yards between the wickets is called ________ .

(a) popping crease  (b) return crease  (c) bowling crease  (d) pitch

ii. In cricket the height of the wickets above the ground is ________ inches.

(a) 24  (b) 26  (c) 28  (d) 30

iii. In cricket the breadth of the pitch is ________ .

(a) 8′-2″  (b) 8′-4″  (c) 8′-6″  (d) 8′-8″

iv. The length of the cricket bat is ________ inches.

(a) 32  (b) 34  (c) 36  (d) 38

v. The weight of the cricket ball is at least ________ grams.

(a) 156  (b) 158  (c) 160  (d) 162

vi. In cricket such a score as is made without the ball touching the bat and body is called ________ .

(a) bye  (b) leg bye  (c) no ball  (d) wide

vii. If while throwing the ball some part of the bowler’s foot goes ahead of the popping crease, it is called ________ .

(a) wide ball  (b) leg ball  (c) no ball  (d) bouncer

2. Write short notes on the following.

i. Responsibilities of the scorer in cricket.

ii. Responsibilities of the umpires.

iii. Ways of being out.

iv. Follow on.
